name: QuestDrop
summary:
QuestDrop moves your personal videos and files between your phone, your PC and your Meta Quest, without cloud uploads or accounts.

HOW IT WORKS
- Install the free QuestDrop companion app on your Android phone (or the PC tool), open QuestDrop on your Quest, and pair once.
- Pick videos on the phone and press Send. They land in your Quest's Movies folder, with live progress and time left.
- Start watching before the copy finishes.

ON YOUR QUEST
- See every video already on the headset, with free space.
